title: Thousands of servers can be backdoored by exploiting buggy motherboard controllers
excerpt: Baseboard management controllers from the world's biggest manufacturers are a security mess.
content_html:
OUT OF BAND; OUT OF MIND

Baseboard management controllers from the world’s biggest manufacturers are a security mess.

A data center corridor lined with rows of locked glass server racks filled with blinking electronic network equipment. Credit: Getty Images

Thousands of Internet-connected servers sold by the world’s biggest manufacturers can be remotely backdoored by exploiting critical vulnerabilities—some more than a decade old—that lurk deep inside system motherboards, according to research presented Wednesday.

Baseboard management controllers are miniature computers that are embedded into the motherboards of virtually every enterprise server. The microcontrollers, typically abbreviated as BMCs, run with their own operating system firmware, network stack, and IP address. Administrators rely on them to monitor the physical status of large fleets of servers and to perform a variety of tasks, including rebooting machines, installing updates, and even reinstalling operating systems. BMCs provide what’s known as “lights out” and “out-of-band” management because they work even when servers they’re attached to are turned off or are unresponsive.

A “pervasive, under-monitored, under-patched parallel attack surface”

Researchers have warned since at least 2013 that BMCs present a golden opportunity for hackers looking for ways to gain deep and persistent access to datacenters. The chief culprit was IPMI, the protocol that allows BMCs to operate independently of servers and to perform administrative tasks. Vulnerabilities in this firmware made it possible for attackers to remotely execute malicious code on the controllers and, from there, infect the servers they manage.

Research presented Wednesday at the Black Hat security conference in Las Vegas shows that little has changed since then. HD Moore, a firmware security expert and the CEO and founder of security firm runZero, uncovered more than a dozen new vulnerabilities in BMCs sold by HPE, Supermicro, Avocent, Huawei, Lenovo, Dell, and others. Moore has also found that some of the weaknesses he warned of in 2013 remain active, despite measures intended to fix them.

“The end result is a pervasive, under-monitored, under-patched parallel attack surface that is both Internet-exposed and widespread inside corporate networks, and is much more exploitable than many folks realize,” Moore wrote in an email ahead of his talk.

To highlight and quantify the threat, Moore oversaw two large-scale scans. One scanned Internet-connected BMCs at large, while the other internally surveyed the devices inside corporate networks. The external scan found more than 86,000 BMCs that exposed a management service to the public. More than 54 percent of those devices contained one or more critical vulnerabilities. As many as 75,000 of them remained vulnerable to CVE-2013-4786, a vulnerability in the IPMI 2.0 authentication protocol that enables off-line cracking of administrator-level BMC account passwords. The internal scan of 126,761 BMCs, meanwhile, found that nearly 29 percent of them had one or more critical vulnerabilities.

A vulnerability list that grows by the day

The number of new vulnerabilities Moore has discovered in the lead-up to this have grown by the day, making it hard to provide a specific number. Because the researcher is keeping vulnerability details confidential until the BMC makers have time to patch them, he’s also not at liberty to disclose many of them individually. Generally speaking, some of the bug classes are:

1. Flaws in the IPMI authentication handshake. Hackers can alter the prescribed sequence of message exchanges in a way that bypasses authentication requirements. This gives an attacker a limited toehold into the BMC. The attacker can then gain administrative access by exploiting other vulnerabilities. Affected products include HPE iLO, Supermicro, OpenBMC, and OpenBMC-derived products from H3C and Nvidia.

2. A failure of IPMI to enforce integrity and encryption protections in-session. “The device decides whether to authenticate and decrypt each packet from that attacker’s own header, and not from the algorithms the session negotiated, so an unsigned, unencrypted command is accepted on a secured session,” Moore said. A proof-of-concept exploit Moore developed uses such bugs to “chain otherwise-unexploitable issues into full sessions.” Affected vendors include HPE, Supermicro, and Intel (legacy).

3. Predictable session identifiers. Session tokens are generated from counters or from a clock rather than secure random sources. This allows an attacker to predict and take over another user’s live BMC session across both the IPMI service and browser-based KVM consoles. The two most significant bugs are both present in Supermicro systems.

4. Pre-authentication memory corruptions. A length-validation error in the management SSH service is reachable before authentication and can be driven to execute malicious code. Moore found the vulnerabilities in HPE iLO systems.

5. The existence of unsigned or attacker-controllable firmware and unenforced configuration integrity. An authenticated administrator can install a persistent implant or replace the key used to verify firmware. These can be chained to separate authentication bypasses and privilege escalation vulnerabilities. Affected vendors include Supermicro, H3C, and Dell.

6. The use of secrets recoverable from firmware as live credentials. Keys and constants that can be extracted from public firmware can be used to authenticate to, or decrypt traffic from, BMCs. Affected vendors include Supermicro, OpenBMC, Huawei, and Dell.

7. Default and factory-random credentials that can be compromised by hash disclosure made possible through CVE-2013-4786. Frequently, devices continue to use default credentials. Even when the credentials have been changed before shipping, the small keyspaces of factory-randomized passwords make them recoverable in offline cracking attacks. Affected vendors include HPE, Supermicro, and Dell. HPE was the worst (eight digits or alphanum), and Supermicro and Dell use slightly longer defaults, which increase the cost of the attack and may delay the cleartext recovery by hours or days, depending on available compute.

While many of the vulnerabilities must be exploited following authentication, that condition generally can be met by exploiting a smaller number of pre-authentication vulnerabilities Moore has identified. In other cases, hackers who gain limited access to a BMC can use it to install an old, unpatched, or backdoored firmware image. Then the hacker can use control of the OS to further tamper with the BMC.

Exploiting BMC vulnerabilities isn’t merely a hypothetical possibility. In 2021, researchers discovered ILObleed, a malicious implant that infected HPE servers with wiper firmware that destroyed data stored on hard drives. Even after administrators reinstalled the operating system, swapped out hard drives, or took other common disinfection steps, ILObleed would remain intact and reactivate the disk-wiping attack. The vulnerability the attackers exploited in that campaign had been patched in HPE BMCs four years earlier but hadn’t been installed in the compromised devices.

Last year, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added a critical vulnerability in an AMI BMC to its known list of exploited vulnerabilities.

Moore has released an open source tool he called OOBscan. Administrators can use it to scan their entire fleet of servers to detect the growing list of BMC vulnerabilities he has cataloged. Beyond running OOBscan, admins can defend against most of these attacks by doing the following:

  • Set long, unique *usernames* and long, complex passwords
  • Disable IPMI wherever possible
  • Disable KCS wherever possible (block host-side access to the BMC)
  • Isolate each BMC NIC individually, avoid placing multiple on a shared VLAN

“BMCs are still an underrated risk,” Moore wrote. “This work points to the ecosystem being well behind the curve in terms of code quality and architecture.”

Dan Goodin is Senior Security Editor at Ars Technica, where he oversees coverage of malware, computer espionage, botnets, hardware hacking, encryption, and passwords. In his spare time, he enjoys gardening, cooking, and following the independent music scene. Dan is based in San Francisco. Follow him at here on Mastodon and here on Bluesky. sentences.en: The two most significant bugs are both present in Supermicro systems.
sentences.zh: 两个最重要的错误都存在于 Supermicro 系统中。

blocks.html_en: 4. Pre-authentication memory corruptions. A length-validation error in the management SSH service is reachable before authentication and can be driven to execute malicious code. Moore found the vulnerabilities in HPE iLO systems.

sentences.en: Pre-authentication memory corruptions.
sentences.zh: 预验证内存损坏。

sentences.en: A length-validation error in the management SSH service is reachable before authentication and can be driven to execute malicious code.
sentences.zh: 管理 SSH 服务中的长度验证错误在身份验证之前即可到达，并且可能会被驱动执行恶意代码。

sentences.en: Moore found the vulnerabilities in HPE iLO systems.
sentences.zh: Moore 发现了 HPE iLO 系统中的漏洞。

blocks.html_en: 5. The existence of unsigned or attacker-controllable firmware and unenforced configuration integrity. An authenticated administrator can install a persistent implant or replace the key used to verify firmware. These can be chained to separate authentication bypasses and privilege escalation vulnerabilities. Affected vendors include Supermicro, H3C, and Dell.

sentences.en: The existence of unsigned or attacker-controllable firmware and unenforced configuration integrity.
sentences.zh: 存在未签名或攻击者可控的固件以及未强制执行的配置完整性。

sentences.en: An authenticated administrator can install a persistent implant or replace the key used to verify firmware.
sentences.zh: 经过身份验证的管理员可以安装持久植入或替换用于验证固件的密钥。

sentences.en: These can be chained to separate authentication bypasses and privilege escalation vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 这些可以链接到单独的身份验证绕过和权限升级漏洞。

sentences.en: Affected vendors include Supermicro, H3C, and Dell.
sentences.zh: 受影响的厂商包括 Supermicro、H3C 和 Dell。

blocks.html_en: 6. The use of secrets recoverable from firmware as live credentials. Keys and constants that can be extracted from public firmware can be used to authenticate to, or decrypt traffic from, BMCs. Affected vendors include Supermicro, OpenBMC, Huawei, and Dell.

sentences.en: The use of secrets recoverable from firmware as live credentials.
sentences.zh: 使用可从固件恢复的秘密作为实时凭证。

sentences.en: Keys and constants that can be extracted from public firmware can be used to authenticate to, or decrypt traffic from, BMCs.
sentences.zh: 从公共固件中提取的密钥和常量可用于对 BMC 的流量进行身份验证或解密。

sentences.en: Affected vendors include Supermicro, OpenBMC, Huawei, and Dell.
sentences.zh: 受影响的厂商包括 Supermicro、OpenBMC、华为和戴尔。

blocks.html_en: 7. Default and factory-random credentials that can be compromised by hash disclosure made possible through CVE-2013-4786. Frequently, devices continue to use default credentials. Even when the credentials have been changed before shipping, the small keyspaces of factory-randomized passwords make them recoverable in offline cracking attacks. Affected vendors include HPE, Supermicro, and Dell. HPE was the worst (eight digits or alphanum), and Supermicro and Dell use slightly longer defaults, which increase the cost of the attack and may delay the cleartext recovery by hours or days, depending on available compute.

sentences.en: Default and factory-random credentials that can be compromised by hash disclosure made possible through CVE-2013-4786.
sentences.zh: 默认和工厂随机凭证可能因通过 CVE-2013-4786 实现的哈希泄露而受到损害。

sentences.en: Frequently, devices continue to use default credentials.
sentences.zh: 通常，设备会继续使用默认凭据。

sentences.en: Even when the credentials have been changed before shipping, the small keyspaces of factory-randomized passwords make them recoverable in offline cracking attacks.
sentences.zh: 即使凭证在发货前已更改，工厂随机密码的小密钥空间也使它们可以在离线破解攻击中恢复。

sentences.en: Affected vendors include HPE, Supermicro, and Dell.
sentences.zh: 受影响的供应商包括 HPE、Supermicro 和 Dell。

sentences.en: HPE was the worst (eight digits or alphanum), and Supermicro and Dell use slightly longer defaults, which increase the cost of the attack and may delay the cleartext recovery by hours or days, depending on available compute.
sentences.zh: HPE 是最差的（八位数字或字母），Supermicro 和 Dell 使用稍长的默认值，这会增加攻击成本，并可能将明文恢复延迟数小时或数天，具体取决于可用的计算。

blocks.html_en: While many of the vulnerabilities must be exploited following authentication, that condition generally can be met by exploiting a smaller number of pre-authentication vulnerabilities Moore has identified. In other cases, hackers who gain limited access to a BMC can use it to install an old, unpatched, or backdoored firmware image. Then the hacker can use control of the OS to further tamper with the BMC.

sentences.en: While many of the vulnerabilities must be exploited following authentication, that condition generally can be met by exploiting a smaller number of pre-authentication vulnerabilities Moore has identified.
sentences.zh: 虽然许多漏洞必须在身份验证后被利用，但通常可以通过利用摩尔已识别的少量预身份验证漏洞来满足该条件。

sentences.en: In other cases, hackers who gain limited access to a BMC can use it to install an old, unpatched, or backdoored firmware image.
sentences.zh: 在其他情况下，获得 BMC 有限访问权限的黑客可以使用它来安装旧的、未修补的或有后门的固件映像。

sentences.en: Then the hacker can use control of the OS to further tamper with the BMC.
sentences.zh: 然后黑客就可以利用对操作系统的控制来进一步篡改BMC。

blocks.html_en: Exploiting BMC vulnerabilities isn’t merely a hypothetical possibility. In 2021, researchers discovered ILObleed, a malicious implant that infected HPE servers with wiper firmware that destroyed data stored on hard drives. Even after administrators reinstalled the operating system, swapped out hard drives, or took other common disinfection steps, ILObleed would remain intact and reactivate the disk-wiping attack. The vulnerability the attackers exploited in that campaign had been patched in HPE BMCs four years earlier but hadn’t been installed in the compromised devices.

sentences.en: Exploiting BMC vulnerabilities isn’t merely a hypothetical possibility.
sentences.zh: 利用 BMC 漏洞不仅仅是一种假设的可能性。

sentences.en: In 2021, researchers discovered ILObleed, a malicious implant that infected HPE servers with wiper firmware that destroyed data stored on hard drives.
sentences.zh: 2021 年，研究人员发现了 ILObleed，这是一种恶意植入程序，它使用擦除器固件感染 HPE 服务器，从而破坏硬盘上存储的数据。

sentences.en: Even after administrators reinstalled the operating system, swapped out hard drives, or took other common disinfection steps, ILObleed would remain intact and reactivate the disk-wiping attack.
sentences.zh: 即使管理员重新安装操作系统、更换硬盘或采取其他常见的消毒步骤后，ILObleed 仍将保持完整并重新激活磁盘擦除攻击。

sentences.en: The vulnerability the attackers exploited in that campaign had been patched in HPE BMCs four years earlier but hadn’t been installed in the compromised devices.
sentences.zh: 攻击者在该活动中利用的漏洞四年前已在 HPE BMC 中修补，但尚未安装在受感染的设备中。

blocks.html_en: Last year, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added a critical vulnerability in an AMI BMC to its known list of exploited vulnerabilities.

sentences.en: Last year, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added a critical vulnerability in an AMI BMC to its known list of exploited vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 去年，网络安全和基础设施安全局将 AMI BMC 中的一个严重漏洞添加到其已知的被利用漏洞列表中。

blocks.html_en: Moore has released an open source tool he called OOBscan. Administrators can use it to scan their entire fleet of servers to detect the growing list of BMC vulnerabilities he has cataloged. Beyond running OOBscan, admins can defend against most of these attacks by doing the following:

sentences.en: Moore has released an open source tool he called OOBscan.
sentences.zh: Moore 发布了一个名为 OOBscan 的开源工具。

sentences.en: Administrators can use it to scan their entire fleet of servers to detect the growing list of BMC vulnerabilities he has cataloged.
sentences.zh: 管理员可以使用它扫描整个服务器群，以检测他列出的不断增加的 BMC 漏洞列表。

sentences.en: Beyond running OOBscan, admins can defend against most of these attacks by doing the following:
sentences.zh: 除了运行 OOBscan 之外，管理员还可以通过执行以下操作来防御大多数此类攻击：

blocks.html_en: • Set long, unique *usernames* and long, complex passwords

sentences.en: Set long, unique *usernames* and long, complex passwords
sentences.zh: 设置长而独特的*用户名*和长而复杂的密码

blocks.html_en: • Disable IPMI wherever possible

sentences.en: Disable IPMI wherever possible
sentences.zh: 尽可能禁用 IPMI

blocks.html_en: • Disable KCS wherever possible (block host-side access to the BMC)

sentences.en: Disable KCS wherever possible (block host-side access to the BMC)
sentences.zh: 尽可能禁用 KCS（阻止主机端对 BMC 的访问）

blocks.html_en: • Isolate each BMC NIC individually, avoid placing multiple on a shared VLAN

sentences.en: Isolate each BMC NIC individually, avoid placing multiple on a shared VLAN
sentences.zh: 单独隔离每个 BMC NIC，避免将多个 BMC NIC 放置在共享 VLAN 上

blocks.html_en: “BMCs are still an underrated risk,” Moore wrote. “This work points to the ecosystem being well behind the curve in terms of code quality and architecture.”

sentences.en: “BMCs are still an underrated risk,” Moore wrote.
sentences.zh: “BMC 仍然是一个被低估的风险，”摩尔写道。

sentences.en: “This work points to the ecosystem being well behind the curve in terms of code quality and architecture.”
sentences.zh: “这项工作表明生态系统在代码质量和架构方面远远落后于曲线。”

content_html_zh:
带外；心不在焉

来自世界上最大制造商的底板管理控制器是一个安全混乱的地方。

数据中心走廊两旁排列着一排排上锁的玻璃服务器机架，里面装满了闪烁的电子网络设备。 图片来源：盖蒂图片社

根据周三公布的研究，全球最大的制造商销售的数千台联网服务器可以通过利用潜伏在系统主板内部的关键漏洞（其中一些已有十多年的历史）来远程设置后门。

基板管理控制器是嵌入到几乎每个企业服务器主板中的微型计算机。 微控制器（通常缩写为 BMC）使用自己的操作系统固件、网络堆栈和 IP 地址运行。 管理员依靠它们来监控大型服务器群的物理状态并执行各种任务，包括重新启动计算机、安装更新，甚至重新安装操作系统。 BMC 提供所谓的“熄灯”和“带外”管理，因为即使它们连接的服务器关闭或无响应，它们也能工作。

“普遍存在、监控不足、修补不足的并行攻击面”

研究人员至少从 2013 年起就警告称，BMC 为寻求对数据中心进行深度、持久访问的黑客提供了绝佳的机会。 罪魁祸首是 IPMI，该协议允许 BMC 独立于服务器运行并执行管理任务。 该固件中的漏洞使攻击者可以在控制器上远程执行恶意代码，并从那里感染他们管理的服务器。

周三在拉斯维加斯举行的黑帽安全会议上公布的研究表明，自那以后，情况几乎没有发生变化。 固件安全专家、安全公司 runZero 的首席执行官兼创始人 HD Moore 在 HPE、Supermicro、Avocent、华为、联想、戴尔等公司销售的 BMC 中发现了十多个新漏洞。 摩尔还发现，他在 2013 年警告的一些弱点仍然存在，尽管采取了旨在修复这些弱点的措施。

摩尔在演讲前的一封电子邮件中写道：“最终结果是一个普遍存在、监控不足、修补不足的并行攻击面，它既暴露在互联网上，又在企业网络内部广泛传播，而且比许多人意识到的更容易被利用。”

为了突出和量化威胁，摩尔监督了两次大规模扫描。 一项扫描了整个互联网连接的 BMC，而另一项则在内部调查了公司网络内的设备。 外部扫描发现超过 86,000 个 BMC 向公众公开了管理服务。 其中超过 54% 的设备包含一个或多个严重漏洞。 其中多达 75,000 个仍然容易受到 CVE-2013-4786 的影响，这是 IPMI 2.0 身份验证协议中的一个漏洞，可以离线破解管理员级 BMC 帐户密码。 与此同时，对 126,761 个 BMC 的内部扫描发现，其中近 29% 存在一个或多个严重漏洞。

与日俱增的漏洞列表

在此之前，摩尔发现的新漏洞数量与日俱增，因此很难提供具体数字。 由于研究人员对漏洞详细信息保密，直到 BMC 制造商有时间修补它们，因此他也无权单独披露其中的许多漏洞。 一般来说，一些错误类别是：

1. IPMI 身份验证握手中存在缺陷。 黑客可以以绕过身份验证要求的方式更改消息交换的规定顺序。 这使得攻击者进入 BMC 的立足点受到限制。 然后，攻击者可以通过利用其他漏洞获得管理访问权限。 受影响的产品包括 HPE iLO、Supermicro、OpenBMC 以及来自 H3C 和 Nvidia 的 OpenBMC 衍生产品。

2. IPMI 未能在会话中实施完整性和加密保护。 “设备决定是否根据攻击者自己的标头来验证和解密每个数据包，而不是根据会话协商的算法，因此在安全会话上接受未签名、未加密的命令，”摩尔说。 Moore 开发的概念验证漏洞利用此类错误“将原本无法利用的问题链接到完整的会话中”。 受影响的供应商包括 HPE、Supermicro 和 Intel（传统）。

3. 可预测的会话标识符。 会话令牌是从计数器或时钟生成的，而不是安全的随机源。 这允许攻击者通过 IPMI 服务和基于浏览器的 KVM 控制台预测并接管另一个用户的实时 BMC 会话。 两个最重要的错误都存在于 Supermicro 系统中。

4. 预验证内存损坏。 管理 SSH 服务中的长度验证错误在身份验证之前即可到达，并且可能会被驱动执行恶意代码。 Moore 发现了 HPE iLO 系统中的漏洞。

5. 存在未签名或攻击者可控的固件以及未强制执行的配置完整性。 经过身份验证的管理员可以安装持久植入或替换用于验证固件的密钥。 这些可以链接到单独的身份验证绕过和权限升级漏洞。 受影响的厂商包括 Supermicro、H3C 和 Dell。

6. 使用可从固件恢复的秘密作为实时凭证。 从公共固件中提取的密钥和常量可用于对 BMC 的流量进行身份验证或解密。 受影响的厂商包括 Supermicro、OpenBMC、华为和戴尔。

7. 默认和工厂随机凭证可能因通过 CVE-2013-4786 实现的哈希泄露而受到损害。 通常，设备会继续使用默认凭据。 即使凭证在发货前已更改，工厂随机密码的小密钥空间也使它们可以在离线破解攻击中恢复。 受影响的供应商包括 HPE、Supermicro 和 Dell。 HPE 是最差的（八位数字或字母），Supermicro 和 Dell 使用稍长的默认值，这会增加攻击成本，并可能将明文恢复延迟数小时或数天，具体取决于可用的计算。

虽然许多漏洞必须在身份验证后被利用，但通常可以通过利用摩尔已识别的少量预身份验证漏洞来满足该条件。 在其他情况下，获得 BMC 有限访问权限的黑客可以使用它来安装旧的、未修补的或有后门的固件映像。 然后黑客就可以利用对操作系统的控制来进一步篡改BMC。

利用 BMC 漏洞不仅仅是一种假设的可能性。 2021 年，研究人员发现了 ILObleed，这是一种恶意植入程序，它使用擦除器固件感染 HPE 服务器，从而破坏硬盘上存储的数据。 即使管理员重新安装操作系统、更换硬盘或采取其他常见的消毒步骤后，ILObleed 仍将保持完整并重新激活磁盘擦除攻击。 攻击者在该活动中利用的漏洞四年前已在 HPE BMC 中修补，但尚未安装在受感染的设备中。

去年，网络安全和基础设施安全局将 AMI BMC 中的一个严重漏洞添加到其已知的被利用漏洞列表中。

Moore 发布了一个名为 OOBscan 的开源工具。 管理员可以使用它扫描整个服务器群，以检测他列出的不断增加的 BMC 漏洞列表。 除了运行 OOBscan 之外，管理员还可以通过执行以下操作来防御大多数此类攻击：

  • 设置长而独特的*用户名*和长而复杂的密码
  • 尽可能禁用 IPMI
  • 尽可能禁用 KCS（阻止主机端对 BMC 的访问）
  • 单独隔离每个 BMC NIC，避免将多个 BMC NIC 放置在共享 VLAN 上

“BMC 仍然是一个被低估的风险，”摩尔写道。 “这项工作表明生态系统在代码质量和架构方面远远落后于曲线。”

Dan Goodin 是 Ars Technica 的高级安全编辑，负责监督恶意软件、计算机间谍活动、僵尸网络、硬件黑客、加密和密码的报道。 业余时间，他喜欢园艺、烹饪和追随独立音乐界。 丹住在旧金山。 请在 Mastodon 和 Bluesky 上关注他。 通过 DanArs.82 上的 Signal 联系他。
